adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent`, the diff sets `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. The `find(...)` branch only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so the predicate compares `cal.externalId === undefined` (or null), which will not match normal calendar IDs and therefore yields `undefined`. This makes `selectedCalendar` undefined in the fallback case, and `calendar.events.update` will be invoked without a valid calendarId (unless downstream code defaults it, which is not shown here).
